sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for facility 233712 (15 sites), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $24 a site (2026-2028 rate tables); two vehicles or one RV included, $11 for a third vehicle. On-site payment by cash, check or money order at the self-service fee tube.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/round-mountain-campground ('$24 fee per site for overnight camping. Two vehicles or one RV per site is included in the camping fee. $11 fee for a third vehicle.'; 'Fees are payable by cash, check or money order. A self-service fee tube is available') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233712/rates (STANDARD NONELECTRIC $24, 2026-2028), read 2026-10-28

values.note: recreation.gov lists 15 sites (14 reservable, 1 first-come), driveways 20-30 ft: 11 at 30 ft, 2 at 25, 2 at 20; site 008 is a pull-through. FS: 'The max length for RVs/trailers is 30 feet.' Up to 8 people, two tents and two vehicles or one RV a site.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 233712 (Max Vehicle Length 20-30 ft; 008 Pull-through) + https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/233712 ('Round Mountain offers about 15 reservable campsites') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/round-mountain-campground ('The max length for RVs/trailers is 30 feet.'; 'A maximum of eight people, two tents and two vehicles or one recreational vehicle (RV) is allowed per site.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: No trash service; pack it out.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/round-mountain-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'There is no trash service at this campground.') + recreation.gov notice (''PACK IN - PACK OUT' facility'), read 2026-10-28

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/round-mountain-campground ('This campground is open mid-May to mid-October, weather dependent.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Reservable on recreation.gov until 5 days before arrival; sites not reserved by then become first-come and must be occupied the same night (site 007 is always first-come). recreation.gov marks the 2-night weekend minimum soft, so it may be relaxed for a same-day booking. 2026 reservation season May 15 - Oct 11 (2027: May 14 - Oct 10). Check-in 2 p.m., check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233712 (notice: 'Reservations are available up to 5 days prior to arrival date. Sites not reserved 5 days before become available on a first come - first serve (FF) bases.'; facility_rules reservationCutOff 5, minWeekendStay 2 soft, maxConsecutiveStay 14) + /rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-10-11; 2027-05-14 to 2027-10-10) + FS page ('First-come, first-served sites must be occupied the same night.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 50% off the campsite the pass holder occupies (concessionaire-run).

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/round-mountain-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites.'), read 2026-10-28

note: Pike NF (South Park RD) campground ~7 mi west of Lake George on US-24, 0.2 mi up a dirt road from the highway (~10 mi west of Florissant), 8,500 ft; widely spaced sites in ponderosa pine and young aspen. Bear closure order in effect (hard-sided storage). --Claude
